descAnimePure.message: Anime4K-Ultra Pure: FSR 1.0 + Soft Thin AA. Preserves 100% original grain, oil paintings, and hand-drawn textures.

descAnimeDbl.message: Anime4K-Ultra Deblur (Recommended): FSR 1.0 + Smart reconstruction with background gating and hue protection.

descAnimeSharp.message: Anime4K-Ultra Sharp: FSR 1.0 + 9-Tap Unsharp Masking. Maximum contour clarity and crisp micro-contrast.

descAnimeDbh.message: Anime4K-Ultra Intense: FSR 1.0 + Heavy Deblur + Deep Ink Punch. Rebuilds blurry line art from low-res sources.

descCinemaFsr.message: Official AMD FSR 1.0 (GPUOpen): 12-Tap EASU + RCAS. Anisotropic spatial reconstruction for movies and live-action video.

descCinemaRaisr.message: Google RAISR: 2D Structure Tensor & steered elliptical filter. Organic sharpness on faces and edges preserving film grain.

descCinemaFsrcnn.message: FSRCNN Neural: EASU geometric base + symmetric PReLU convolution. Ultra-clean cinema clarity with compression denoising.
